description: This Java class 'ReportParameters' serves as a utility class providing constant definitions, descriptive documentation, and annotations for API parameter documentation related to report generation and querying in the Apache Fineract project. It primarily contains string constants for parameter names, detailed full descriptions of report capabilities, and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for automated API documentation.
